title: REQ · Lookup returns the ExecutionInfo for the current Round
summary: Current-Round execution lookup built on getCurrentRound and listExecutions
description: Context: Executions carry round_id; the public current Round comes from getCurrentRound. Desired behavior: a pure findExecutionForRound(list, roundId) and an async getCurrentRoundExecution(token, worldId) that composes them. Expected result: the matching ExecutionInfo, newest by updated_at when several match, else undefined. Why: the admin console shows the current Round's execution.
acceptance_criteria: Given executions for round-1 and round-2 and current round round-1, when getCurrentRoundExecution runs, then the round-1 execution is returned
Given no execution for the current round, when it runs, then undefined is returned
Given two executions for the current round, when it runs, then the one with the later updated_at is returned
technical_constraints: updated_at is RFC 3339 so string comparison orders it
